title: Reefer Cargo Services: Setting Change Allowances, Fees and Cut-Off Hours
content:
A shipper may alter the carrying settings of a Reefer Cargo Services unit a limited number of times. Each tier sets how many alterations come without a fee, how many are taken in total over the life of one service, the fee for a pre-departure alteration once the free ones are used, whether the settings can still be altered remotely once the vessel has sailed and at what price, and how many hours ahead of the scheduled departure the last pre-departure alteration may arrive.

| Tier | Free changes per service | Most changes taken per service | Fee per change before departure beyond the free ones (USD) | Remote change after sailing possible | Fee per remote change after sailing (USD) | Cut-off (hours before scheduled departure) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 1 | 3 | 45.00 | no | 0.00 | 24 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 2 | 5 | 40.00 | yes | 35.00 | 12 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 2 | 1 | 60.00 | no | 0.00 | 48 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 1 | 2 | 90.00 | no | 0.00 | 48 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 0 | 5 | 150.00 | yes | 75.00 | 24 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 1 | 2 | 120.00 | no | 0.00 | 24 |

## Column meanings

- *Free changes* counts alterations that carry no fee on that service.
- *Most changes taken* is the ceiling on alterations accepted over the service's life.
- *Remote change after sailing* shows whether the tier lets the settings be altered from shore once the vessel is at sea; the fee beside it is charged per such alteration and reads 0.00 where the facility is not offered.
- *Cut-off* is stated in whole hours before the scheduled departure.

## Quick answers from the table

- Only Monitored and Pharma GDP allow remote alteration after sailing.
- Pharma GDP gives no free alteration at all, while Monitored gives two and accepts up to five.
- Cold Treatment and Controlled Atmosphere need the longest notice, 48 hours; Monitored the shortest, 12 hours.
